findings.note: Ball A starts from the 10 m tower, so its height above the ground is 10 + 10t − 5t², not 20 + 10t − 5t². With the printed 20 the two heights differ by 10t and the balls would meet only at t = 0; the next line silently uses 10, so the printed equation is false and contradicts the step that follows it.

findings.quote: Treating the fall term as different for the two particles instead of letting it cancel leads to an incorrect collision time and a wrong horizontal distance.
findings.note: Both balls carry the same −½gt² term from the same instant, so no natural student error makes the fall terms differ; the entry names no concrete wrong step and no wrong number, so it does not describe a real mistake for this question.
findings.fix: Measuring each height from its own tower top instead of from the ground drops the 10 m difference in tower heights, giving 10t − 5t² = −5t² and t = 0, so no meeting time is found.
